description: MusicAtlas is the fastest way to discover music through sound across major streaming services. Find songs that sound like a track you love, explore similar artists, understand what makes a song sound the way it does, and discover playlists for any mood, genre, activity, or vibe. Listen to playable previews and jump to your favorite music service to hear more.
